purpose: Combine public police education, standards, institutional research, official news and public judicial/procuratorial cases to understand high-level investigative logic, evidence domains and demonstrated capabilities for defensive legal/compliance review.

two_view_model.source_view: Infer declared investigative doctrine and capability domains from public laws, police-school curricula, standards, official research, institutional media and forensic-science publications.
two_view_model.outcome_view: Infer demonstrated evidence combinations and practical capability from public cases, judgments, procuratorial technical cases and official case reports.
two_view_model.cross_validation_rule: A capability is stronger when the source view and outcome view independently converge; material conclusions still require current law and primary-case verification.

capability_domains.name: 侦查组织、线索研判与证据导向逻辑
capability_domains.safe_scope: High-level investigative workflow, hypothesis testing, evidence corroboration and case organization only.

capability_domains.name: 现场勘查与物证体系
capability_domains.safe_scope: Public forensic categories such as traces, documents, imaging, chemistry and scene reconstruction; no counter-forensics.

capability_domains.name: 电子数据取证与真实性/完整性审查
capability_domains.safe_scope: Devices, files, logs, databases, cloud/network records, imaging, integrity and authenticity at category level.

capability_domains.name: 网络犯罪侦查
capability_domains.safe_scope: Publicly documented network evidence, account/network/terminal attribution and cybercrime evidence logic; no exploitation or evasion detail.

capability_domains.name: 身份、账号、网络活动与终端关联
capability_domains.safe_scope: How public cases combine registration, logs, terminal/network activity and other evidence to establish identity, without avoidance guidance.

capability_domains.name: 资金流与交易证据分析
capability_domains.safe_scope: Bank/payment/merchant transaction evidence and corroboration at legal-evidence level.

capability_domains.name: 通信与内容证据
capability_domains.safe_scope: Messages, email, platform content and related provenance/authenticity categories.

capability_domains.name: 视频、图像与音频证据
capability_domains.safe_scope: Public forensic examination, enhancement/authenticity and evidentiary use at category level.

capability_domains.name: 法医、生物与人体损伤证据
capability_domains.safe_scope: Public forensic medicine and biological-evidence categories.

capability_domains.name: 数据警务、情报研判与跨来源关联
capability_domains.safe_scope: High-level multi-source correlation and analytical reasoning; no covert collection instructions.

capability_domains.name: 地理、遥感、无人机与现场技术证据
capability_domains.safe_scope: Only publicly documented lawful evidence applications and geospatial compliance boundaries.

capability_domains.name: 平台、运营商及机构持有记录
capability_domains.safe_scope: Lawful request/cooperation and record categories, not access circumvention.

capability_domains.name: 讯问、询问与言词证据
capability_domains.safe_scope: Legal procedure, voluntariness, corroboration and evidentiary review only; no coercive or manipulative tactics.

capability_domains.name: 技术侦查公开法定边界
capability_domains.safe_scope: Existence, statutory case scope, approval, target, duration and use restrictions only; no technical implementation.
